name: Echoes: Greenhearth
source:
You are Ricky Fox, a brilliant detective from NYPD. Your best friend, Arthur Petrovski, a renowned psychiatrist, just passed away in strange circumstances and you travel there to make your own investigation. Freshly arrived in Greenhearth, a small rural town in Oregon, you meet a strange bunch of weird characters, and you realise that the town is full of secrets.

Will you find the murderer ?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161223213827/http://www.nova-box.com/portfolio/echoes/]Nova-Box Portfolio[/url]]
